notes: With-skill passed 16/16 assertions (1.00) across 3 evals; baseline passed 10/16 (0.63 mean).
Baseline failures concentrate on skill-specific deliverables: single-source data + derived highlights, canonical/sitemap/llms.txt, PNG logo, cache/perf config, documented naming candidates.
With-skill runs were FASTER on average (838s vs 1170s) despite producing more complete outputs — the scaffold script offsets skill-reading overhead.

Token cost is slightly higher with skill (~+18k on average), mostly from reading SKILL.md/references and one eval verifying astro registry versions (found ^5.0.0 pin vs latest 7.4.13 — actionable scaffold update).
Assertions 'README + screenshot plan' pass in both configs — weakly discriminating; keep for completeness but do not read into it.
Environment constraint: npm install/build not run, so no build-time verification; screenshots were documented plans by rule, not fabricated.
Baseline eval-2 cited UI options by name without URLs (offline env), so 'cites 3 sources' failed on links count, not on substance.
